replacements.why: The dual-host paragraph names Claude Code and opencode, neither of which is the Prime Agent host, names a Skill/skill tool Prime does not have for invoking impeccable, and claims an allowed-tools frontmatter this overlay drops. Prime has no picker and opens no page, so it asks in numbered prose and defaults to text mode, as the Hosts table already says.
replacements.find:
**Dual-host.** This single `SKILL.md` serves both Claude Code and opencode via the
in-place dual-host pattern — there is **no** `.opencode/skills/envision/` override port.
Where a host construct differs, both variants are named inline: `AskUserQuestion`
(Claude) / `question` (opencode); `Skill` (Claude) / `skill` (opencode) to invoke
impeccable. The `allowed-tools` frontmatter lists both host variants of every tool the
body uses.
replacements.replace:
**Host.** This is the Prime Agent port of a skill whose source serves several hosts from
one `SKILL.md`. Where the body below names a host construct, use the Prime equivalent:
ask the user normally in the conversation, as numbered choices, instead of
`AskUserQuestion`/`question`. `Skill`/`skill` does not exist here, so impeccable is never
invoked at Feel: say so in one line, print no command, and go on to the tiles. Text mode is
the default, and the board's path is printed rather than opened. This port carries **no** `allowed-tools` frontmatter —
Prime Agent does not read one — so the tools the body uses are the ordinary shell and file
tools the session already has. The skill still never commits and never pushes.
